digest.component_or_area: CLI command parsing and help generation system
propositions: Command syntax is fragmented across imperative argv loops, hand-maintained help files, and multiple parser implementations, creating documentation and runtime disagreement.
A consolidated registry and side-effect-free argparse factory protocol must replace duplicate parsers while preserving Rebar's diagnostic shape and compatibility routing.
Generated package help and grouped overview must be byte-deterministic and serve from the factory registry before operation/config/store/handler boundaries.
Parser migrations must maintain accepted/rejected argv parity, diagnostic output, and exit-code behavior verified by comprehensive test oracles before switching runtime handlers.
Exact command aliases reuse canonical artifacts; retired/hidden commands remain unknown and undiscoverable after migration.
Existing command execution continues via the compatibility route ladder while all selected handlers consume their shared factory.
